kultivator.hub.card.sekte_seragam_lamban: Design the sect's emblem, motto and the uniform of every disciple rank. The emblem flies on the gate and formation banners.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.sumber: Source: the robe and bowl the Fifth Patriarch Hongren passed to Huineng as the mark of the lineage (Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch); the plain and bordered banners of the Qing dynasty's Eight Banners that told the companies apart.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.adv.lambang.des: Design and save your sect's emblem in the Emblem & Uniform designer.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.adv.bendera.des: Stand near a finished flagpole of your sect.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.saved.free: Sect design saved. The banners and the disciples' robes change.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.saved.paid: Sect design saved (%s CP from the hall pool).
kultivator.sekte.seragam.not_master: Only the Sect Master may change the emblem and uniform.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.no_hall: Found a Sect Hall first: the emblem is kept in the hall.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.no_pk: Today's free change is used and the hall pool holds less than %s CP.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.log.heir: An heir was named: one day the robe embroidered with the sect's emblem will pass to them.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.log.generation: The Sect Master of generation %s takes the seat; a new gold knot is stitched on every banner's top hem.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.log.changed: The sect's emblem and uniform were renewed. Motto: %s
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ingat.jubah: The Master gave us new robes with the sect's emblem. Motto: %s
kultivator.sekte.seragam.info.motto: Motto "%s", generation %s, version %s, free changes left %s
kultivator.sekte.seragam.info.banners: Banners at the hall: %s, formation decals: %s
kultivator.sekte.seragam.cmd.preview: A test banner stands in front of you for 30 seconds.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.cmd.atlas: The client saves the emblem textures to the screenshots folder.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.cmd.atlas.done: %s emblem texture slots written to screenshots/kultivator_lambang_*.png.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.cmd.reset: Sect design reset to the default.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.cmd.set: Test emblem saved: shape %s, symbol %s, colours %s/%s/%s.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.title: Sect Emblem & Uniform
Shape, symbol, three colours and the sect's motto.
Robe colour, trim colour and cut for every disciple rank.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.warna.0.tip: The colour of the emblem's field and of the banner cloth.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.warna.1.tip: The colour of the symbol and of the banner's flame-tooth edges.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.warna.2.tip: The colour of the emblem's border and of the banner's hems.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.potongan.0.t: Ankle-long robe with wide sleeves: for ceremony and seclusion.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.potongan.1.t: Knee-length robe with bound leggings: nimble for duties and travel.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.potongan.2.t: A close-cut robe with a slit skirt, leather bracers, a plated belt and quilted shoulders.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.salin.tip: Use this rank's colours and cut for all six ranks.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.acak.tip: A random emblem: a new shape, symbol and colours.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.batal.tip: Discard the changes not yet saved.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.simpan.tip: Banners, formation decals and the disciples' robes take the new design.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.asli.tip: Keep today's look: the robe in the disciple's Dao colour, trims in its rank colour.
kultivator.sekte.seragam.ui.bukan_ketua: Only the Sect Master can change the design.
